summary.headline: Max Estates FY26 presales hit INR5,305 crore, second straight year above INR5,000 crore, with Q4 bookings of INR3,300 crore the strongest quarter ever.
summary.overview: Management reported FY26 residential presales of INR5,305 crore and collections of INR1,578 crore (up 61% YoY), with Q4 bookings of INR3,300 crore driven by Estate 105 and Max One launches. Total revenue from launched projects yet to be recognised stands at INR16,310 crore, of which INR12,500 crore is already sold, with embedded PBT of INR4,200-4,900 crore. Consolidated FY26 revenue was INR200 crore, PBT INR23 crore, and net debt about INR100 crore. Management declined to give FY27 presales guidance, citing a moderating NCR market and West Asia-related cost and sentiment pressure.

strongest quarter ever, driven by Estate 105 and Max One

financial_highlights.value: INR23,000 per sq ft in FY26
financial_highlights.change: from INR18,000 in FY24 (29% rise over 2 years)
up 40% YoY; Q4 reported rental income up about 43% per analyst
of which INR970 crore is lease rental discounting

segments.name: Residential - Estate 361 (Gurugram)
segments.commentary: Phase 1 presales about INR1,700 crore in FY26, over 68% absorption of launch inventory, at about INR22,000 per sq ft. The Terraces launched May 2026 (GDV about INR1,200 crore) as a new precinct; remaining Phase 2 inventory expected around Q3 FY27.

segments.name: Residential - Estate 128 (Noida)
segments.commentary: Fully sold, cumulative presales INR2,700 crore, collections INR1,100 crore to date. Delivery on track for CY2027; Phase 1 at 35th-36th floor slab.

segments.name: Residential - Estate 360 (Gurugram)
segments.commentary: Cumulative presales INR4,800 crore, collections INR1,600 crore; ground floor complete for Towers 1-2, first-floor slab for Towers 3 and 5.

segments.name: Residential - Estate 105 and Max One (Noida)
segments.commentary: Estate 105 launched 20 March 2026, about INR1,800 crore sold in 10 days; GDV doubled from INR3,000 crore to INR6,000 crore with serviced apartments, Phase 2 in FY28. Max One contributed INR1,400 crore to FY26 presales after RERA approval in March 2026; GDV over INR3,200 crore.

segments.name: Commercial annuity
segments.commentary: Three operating assets (Max Towers, Max House, Max Square) at 100% occupancy, 1.2 million sq ft leased. Annual lease rentals: Max Towers INR53 crore, Max House INR45 crore, Max Square INR60 crore. Max District pre-leased LOI of about 2 lakh sq ft at gross rentals above INR270 crore; Max Square Two pre-leased about 80,000 sq ft, rentals above INR95 crore.

segments.name: Max Asset Services
segments.commentary: Contributed INR88 crore to FY26 consolidated revenue.

guidance_outlook: No presales guidance for FY27; management declined to comment on whether growth would be flat, or mid-to-high single to low double digit.
About INR17,000 crore GDV yet to come to market, to be launched in phases; Sector 59 Golf Course Extension (GDV about INR3,900 crore, RERA not yet filed) targeted for Q3 FY27.
The Terraces launched in Q1 FY27; Estate 105 and Max One launches between Q2 and Q3 FY27; remaining Estate 361 inventory around Q3 FY27.

FY27 collections expected at INR2,500-3,000 crore (INR1,200-1,500 crore from existing sales plus INR1,200-1,500 crore from new sales); project deployment INR1,500-1,800 crore, implying positive operating cash flow.

Max Square Two occupancy certificate expected Q2 FY28; Max District delivered in two phases (Q2 FY28 and Q3 FY29). Commercial annuity to exceed INR350 crore after these assets; total 5-year annuity potential above INR700 crore on 100% basis.
Residential pipeline target of about 2 million sq ft and commercial about 1 million sq ft added annually, via outright acquisition and joint development; no land acquired from debt.

qa_highlights.question: Will management give FY27 presales guidance and launch pipeline by GDV and timing?
qa_highlights.answer: No presales guidance for FY27 given the evolving macro; about INR17,000 crore GDV yet to launch in phases, including The Terraces and Sector 59 (about INR3,900 crore). Declined to say whether growth would be flat or mid-to-high single digit.

qa_highlights.question: How is demand across Terraces (about INR2.5 crore tickets) and Max One (INR20-25 crore tickets)?
qa_highlights.answer: Sentiment cautious across all segments, longer decision cycles, but no complete slowdown; more end-user demand coming through.

qa_highlights.question: Why did Q4 rental income rise about 43% when leased area and rents look flat?
qa_highlights.answer: Mainly an Ind AS rent equalisation adjustment after rent-free periods; rentals reset on 3+3+3 leases with 15% escalation every 3 years. FY26 rental income about INR155 crore; peak-occupancy run-rate for existing assets about INR210 crore over 5 years.

qa_highlights.question: What is the RERA status and why did Sector 59 GDV rise about 30%?
qa_highlights.answer: RERA not yet filed. Revised GDV reflects micro-market pricing and a product spec-up aligned to demand.

qa_highlights.question: What are the Max One cash flows and the inherited sales economics?
qa_highlights.answer: About 1.4 million sq ft of 2.5 million sq ft was sold by the erstwhile developer; company expects about INR550-600 crore incremental receipts on the INR1,221 crore base. Remaining 1.1 million sq ft targeted for residential (about INR2,000 crore) and annuity (about INR140 crore).

qa_highlights.question: FY27 collections, deployment and operating cash flow?
qa_highlights.answer: Collections INR2,500-3,000 crore (INR1,200-1,500 crore from existing sales plus INR1,200-1,500 crore from new sales); deployment INR1,500-1,800 crore, implying positive OCF. FY26 OCF about INR450-500 crore.

qa_highlights.question: How is the balance sheet funded, and is debt used for land?
qa_highlights.answer: No land acquired from debt; residential RERA account surplus about INR1,200 crore sufficient for construction; commercial equity in place and construction finance to be taken out via LRD after leasing; LRD cover from lease rentals at 100% occupancy.

qa_highlights.question: How are inflation and cost pressures being managed?
qa_highlights.answer: Budgets include escalation and contingency buffers; so far inflation impact absorbed, but prolonged geopolitical strain could raise impact. Management aspires to achieve the margin band in the presentation.

capex_capacity: Estate 361 (Gurugram) Phase 1 at over 68% absorption of launch inventory; The Terraces launched May 2026 with GDV about INR1,200 crore; remaining Estate 361 inventory around Q3 FY27.
Estate 128 (Noida) fully sold, delivery on track for CY2027; Phase 1 at 35th-36th floor slab, Phase 2 at third-floor slab.
Estate 360 (Gurugram): ground floor complete for Towers 1-2, first-floor slab Towers 3 and 5, second-floor slab Towers 4 and 6.

Estate 105 GDV raised from INR3,000 crore to INR6,000 crore with serviced apartments; Phase 2 planned FY28. Max One (2.5 million sq ft, GDV over INR3,200 crore) post RERA approval March 2026, annuity potential about INR140 crore.

Max Square Two (about 1 million sq ft leasable) OC expected Q2 FY28; Max District (about 1.6 million sq ft) in two phases, Q2 FY28 and Q3 FY29. Sector 59 Golf Course Extension (GDV about INR3,900 crore, RERA not yet filed) targeted for Q3 FY27; about INR17,000 crore GDV yet to come to market.
demand_pricing: Q4 FY26 bookings INR3,300 crore, driven by Estate 105 (launched 20 March 2026, about INR1,800 crore sold in 10 days) and Max One (INR1,400 crore FY26 presales, of which about INR1,200 crore was inherited sales from the erstwhile developer per analyst).

Average realisation rose from INR18,000 per sq ft in FY24 to about INR20,000 in FY25 and INR23,000 in FY26; Estate 361 Phase 1 at about INR22,000 per sq ft; The Terraces priced at a premium to previous Estate 361 phase.

Management described demand as cautious across ticket sizes (Terraces about INR2.5 crore; luxury and ultra-luxury; Max One ticket sizes INR20-25 crore plus), but not a slowdown; cancellations described as negligible.
Commercial: NCR office leasing about 2.8 million sq ft in Q4 (up 36% QoQ); NCR rental growth about 15% YoY; Max Towers, Max House and Max Square at 100% occupancy.
Max District pre-leasing LOI about 2 lakh sq ft at gross rentals above INR270 crore (35% premium to micro market); Max Square Two pre-leased about 80,000 sq ft, gross rentals above INR95 crore.
risks_watch: No FY27 presales guidance; NCR residential moderation over last 6 months and West Asia-related cost and sentiment pressure.
Launch execution: about INR17,000 crore GDV to launch, with Sector 59 (about INR3,900 crore, RERA not yet filed) targeted Q3 FY27 and Estate 105/Max One launches between Q2 and Q3 FY27.
Construction cost inflation over 3-5 year delivery horizons; sustainability of margin band depends on escalation and contingency buffers.

Max One revenue recognition depends on inherited 1.4 million sq ft sales and incremental receipts of INR550-600 crore; annuity ramp depends on Max Square Two (Q2 FY28) and Max District (Q2 FY28, Q3 FY29) occupancy certificates.
Collections and OCF targets for FY27 (INR2,500-3,000 crore collections) depend on new sales that management has not guided.
key_quotes: Max Estates still crossed INR5,300 crores in presales for the second consecutive year, affirming the strength of our platform and the trust that our clients and our stakeholders place in us.
A substantial majority of our future reported revenue is already contracted, derisking the earnings trajectory materially.

So, we are cautiously optimistic. And as you said, yes, it's primarily driven by the macroeconomic scenario, and we are hopeful that if things settle, things continue to be very optimistic in the future.
So, I will refrain from commenting on that at this time, Mohit.
summary.management_tone: Confident on balance sheet, backlog (INR12,500 crore sold but unrecognised) and commercial occupancy, but cautious and evasive on FY27 presales, citing a moderating NCR market and West Asia conflict.

adds.what: The Terraces, Estate 361 Gurugram new precinct (GDV about INR1,200 crore)
Max District commercial, about 1.6 million sq ft leasable, phase 1 (Q2 FY28)
Max Square Two commercial, about 1 million sq ft leasable (OC expected Q2 FY28)
Estate 105 Phase 2 serviced apartments (GDV raised to INR6,000 crore total, Phase 2 in FY28)

growth.why: Management declined to give FY27 presales guidance citing a moderating NCR market and West Asia pressure, so no revenue growth number is guided; backing is partial with FY27 collections of INR2,500-3,000 crore, ~INR12,500 crore of sold revenue yet to recognise, Max District and Max Square Two pre-leases, and ~INR17,000 crore GDV yet to launch, but no FY27 presales or revenue growth target.
